entries.title: Matthew 4:1
segments: ¶Then Jesus was carried up into the wilderness by the Spirit to be tempted of the devil:

entries.title: Matthew 4:2
segments: and having fasted forty days and forty nights, afterwards he hungered.

entries.title: Matthew 4:3
segments: And the tempter coming up to him said, If thou be Son of God, speak, that these stones may become loaves of bread.

entries.title: Matthew 4:4
segments: But he answering said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word which goes out through God's mouth.

entries.title: Matthew 4:5
segments: Then the devil takes him to the holy city, and sets him upon the edge of the temple,

entries.title: Matthew 4:6
segments: and says to him, If thou be Son of God cast thyself down; for it is written, He shall give charge to his angels concerning thee, and on [their] hands shall they bear thee, lest in anywise thou strike thy foot against a stone.

entries.title: Matthew 4:7
segments: Jesus said to him, It is again written, Thou shalt not tempt [the] Lord thy God.

entries.title: Matthew 4:8
segments: Again the devil takes him to a very high mountain, and shews him all the kingdoms of the world, and their glory,

entries.title: Matthew 4:9
segments: and says to him, All these things will I give thee if, falling down, thou wilt do me homage.

entries.title: Matthew 4:10
segments: Then says Jesus to him, Get thee away, Satan, for it is written, Thou shalt do homage to [the] Lord thy God, and him alone shalt thou serve.

entries.title: Matthew 4:11
segments: Then the devil leaves him, and behold, angels came and ministered to him.

entries.title: Matthew 4:12
segments: ¶But having heard that John was delivered up, he departed into Galilee:

entries.title: Matthew 4:13
segments: and having left Nazareth, he went and dwelt at Capernaum, which is on the sea-side in the borders of Zabulon and Nepthalim,

entries.title: Matthew 4:14
segments: that that might be fulfilled which was spoken through Esaias the prophet, saying,

entries.title: Matthew 4:15
segments: Land of Zabulon and land of Nepthalim, way of [the] sea beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations:

entries.title: Matthew 4:16
segments: --the people sitting in darkness has seen a great light, and to those sitting in [the] country and shadow of death, to them has light sprung up.

entries.title: Matthew 4:17
segments: From that time began Jesus to preach and to say, Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has drawn nigh.

entries.title: Matthew 4:18
segments: ¶And walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishers;

entries.title: Matthew 4:19
segments: and he says to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.

entries.title: Matthew 4:20
segments: And they, having left their trawl-nets, immediately followed him.

entries.title: Matthew 4:21
segments: And going on thence he saw other two brothers, James the [son] of Zebedee and John his brother, in the ship with Zebedee their father, mending their trawl-nets, and he called them;

entries.title: Matthew 4:22
segments: and they, having left the ship and their father, immediately followed him.

entries.title: Matthew 4:23
segments: ¶And [Jesus] went round the whole [of] Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the glad tidings of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every bodily weakness among the people.

entries.title: Matthew 4:24
segments: And his fame went out into the whole [of] Syria, and they brought to him all that were ill, suffering under various diseases and pains, and those possessed by demons, and lunatics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

entries.title: Matthew 4:25
segments: And great crowds followed him from Galilee, and Decapolis, and Jerusalem, and Judaea, and beyond the Jordan.
